name: Search for function usages
prompt: Find all usages of the function total_value across the entire codebase. For each occurrence, tell me the file, the line number, and whether it's a definition, a call, or a test.
expected_behavior: Agent searches the codebase and finds total_value in: inventory.rs (definition as Item method, called in total_inventory_value, called in test_total_value, called in test_total_inventory_value), report.rs (called inside CategorySummary generation, called in test_summarize_item).
success_criteria: Finds occurrences in both inventory.rs and report.rs
Correctly distinguishes definition from call from test
